direction.thesis: The agent designs with your brand and you approve what goes out.
direction.signatureMove: accent circle that bleeds off the cover

slides.alt: Cover: "Your brand in every piece" in large type, with an orange circle that runs off the edge.

slides.claim: The agent starts from what is approved
slides.alt: Dark background with the line "The agent starts from what you already approved".
List of four steps: ask by chat, write the copy, design and review, hand over for approval.
Two columns, before and now: from one brief per post to one request by chat; from three rounds of changes to one fix; from designing from scratch to approved templates.
Close: "You decide what gets published" and the invitation to send AGENT by direct message.

captions.instagram:
We build the week's content with an agent that reads our brand kit, writes in our voice and hands us files to review. Every correction we give it shows up in the next piece.

Nothing goes out until we approve it.

DM us AGENT and we'll show you the full workflow.

#brandcontent #carousels
captions.linkedin:
We stopped briefing every post from scratch.

Now we ask an agent for the piece. It works from our brand kit, our templates and the corrections we have given it along the way. It writes the copy, builds the design, checks it at phone size and hands us editable files.

The decision about what gets published is still ours.

How much time does your team spend on each piece?
